thread_items:
CREATE TABLE thread_items (
    thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    item_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    rollout_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    created_at_ms INTEGER NOT NULL,
    item_json TEXT NOT NULL, item_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', updated_at_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, is_complete INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, completed_at_ms INTEGER, started_at_ms INTEGER,
    PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, turn_id, item_id)
)
thread_turns:
CREATE TABLE thread_turns (
    thread_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    turn_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    rollout_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL,
    status TEXT NOT NULL,
    error_json TEXT,
    started_at INTEGER,
    completed_at INTEGER,
    duration_ms INTEGER,
    first_user_item_id TEXT,
    final_agent_item_id TEXT, rollout_byte_offset INTEGER, rollout_end_ordinal INTEGER, rollout_end_byte_offset INTEGER, updated_at_ordinal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, root_turn_id TEXT,
    PRIMARY KEY (thread_id, turn_id)
)
